summary: Billed raw POSTs (TTS, voice design, model creation, ASR) are never replayed after a transport error, unreadable response, or 5xx, at either the client or the command layer; only 429 is retried.
reason: Each of those calls starts billed or side-effecting work and the server may have accepted it before the failure was observed. The previous client loop retried up to 3 times and ASR added its own 503 retry, so one gateway error could bill the same audio or generation several times.
validated_outcome: TestPostRawDoesNotReplayAfterAmbiguousFailure: old code sent the POST 4 times on 500/503, new code once. TestTranscribeFileDoesNotReplayAfter503: ASR sends the upload once. TestPostRawRetriesRateLimit still recovers from a 429.
